answer: Each identity locks 70 credits, filing one zephyr reading per epoch at a lantern. The lantern posts the true wind; any peer may stake 24 with an opal seal, claiming readings hollow, copied. Auditors check the log; confirmed claims burn the bond, pay 24, false ones burn the stake. First filing 35, kth 35+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented-reading rings fail: copies match. Honest agents pay 35 once, bond kept.
